# UFO / UAP source data

Real case files (PURSUE, Blue Book, FOIA), sighting datasets, analysis and evidence UIs, sky reconstruction, and disclosure timelines. Read the data-licensing notes before shipping anything.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/ufo-data.md](../notes/ufo-data.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category ufo-data`
